# Technology Domain - API & Microservices Technology Patterns

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Patterns](../../README.md) • [Technology](../README.md)**

This directory contains technology selection, performance, and deployment patterns for API and microservices within the **Technology Domain**. These patterns focus on technology choices, performance optimization, scalability, and deployment strategies.
page_texts.2:
[patterns/technology/api-microservices/README.md#overview]

## Overview

Technology patterns for APIs and microservices address:

- **Performance Optimization**: Caching, async processing, and performance tuning
- **Scalability**: Horizontal and vertical scaling strategies
- **Deployment Strategies**: Blue-green, canary, and rolling deployments
- **Technology Selection**: Choosing appropriate technologies and frameworks
- **Configuration Management**: Externalized configuration and feature flags

[patterns/technology/api-microservices/README.md#patterns-in-this-category]

## Patterns in this Category

| Pattern ID | Name | Purpose |
|------------|------|---------|
| [PTN-TEC-API-001](./PTN-TEC-API-001-blue-green-deployment-pattern.md) | **Blue-Green Deployment Pattern** | Zero-downtime deployment strategy with instant rollback capability |
| [PTN-TEC-API-002](./PTN-TEC-API-002-canary-deployment-pattern.md) | **Canary Deployment Pattern** | Progressive rollout with traffic shifting to minimize risk |
| [PTN-TEC-API-003](./PTN-TEC-API-003-externalized-configuration-pattern.md) | **Externalized Configuration Pattern** | Environment-independent configuration management |
| [PTN-TEC-API-004](./PTN-TEC-API-004-asynchronous-processing-pattern.md) | **Asynchronous Processing Pattern** | Non-blocking request handling for improved performance |
| [PTN-TEC-API-005](./PTN-TEC-API-005-caching-pattern.md) | **Caching Pattern** | Performance optimization through intelligent caching strategies |
| [PTN-TEC-API-006](./PTN-TEC-API-006-response-compression-pattern.md) | **Response Compression Pattern** | Bandwidth optimization through response compression |
| [PTN-TEC-API-007](./PTN-TEC-API-007-horizontal-scaling-pattern.md) | **Horizontal Scaling Pattern** | Scalability through horizontal instance scaling |
| [PTN-TEC-API-008](./PTN-TEC-API-008-load-shedding-pattern.md) | **Load Shedding Pattern** | Graceful degradation under high load conditions |
| [PTN-TEC-API-009](./PTN-TEC-API-009-api-throttling-pattern.md) | **API Throttling Pattern** | Rate limiting and traffic control for stability |
| [PTN-TEC-API-010](./PTN-TEC-API-010-technology-event-broker-selection-pattern.md) | **Technology Event Broker Selection Pattern** | Selecting appropriate event broker technology for requirements |

*Note: See individual pattern files for complete documentation.*
